This repo serves one site, Príklad Rent (a fictional car and van rental in Bratislava), in Slovak and English under one origin, so no per-site folders exist (no `sites/`, `apps/`, or `tenants/`). The only per-deployment config is `SITE_URL` in `.env.example`, read by `lib/site.ts:3` with the default `http://localhost:3102`, and the root AGENTS.md and README.md list no other sites.
